nodes.label: revealAll()
nodes.rationale: Failsafe: marks every [data-reveal] element revealed on beforeprint and 3s after load if the observer never fired (renderers that paint no frames).

nodes.label: Opt-in Scroll Reveal (window.__reveal, IntersectionObserver)
nodes.rationale: Reveals are opt-in progressive enhancement: without JS, IntersectionObserver, or with prefers-reduced-motion nothing is hidden; the reveal-ready class is only added when the observer can run.

nodes.label: Build-time Server-Side Prerender into dist/index.html
nodes.rationale: Server-renders the portfolio into dist/index.html before Vite bundles client assets so portfolio text is present in the initial HTML (crawlers, link previews) while React hydrates in the browser.
